questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Which of the following physical quantities has the dimensional formula [M¹ L² T⁻³]?
questions.explanation: Power = Work / Time = [M¹ L² T⁻²] / [T] = [M¹ L² T⁻³].
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 2: Units and Measurements

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The area under a Velocity-Time graph represents which physical quantity?
questions.explanation: The area enclosed under a velocity-time graph gives the total displacement of the body over that time interval.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 3: Motion in a Straight Line

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the molarity of a solution containing 4 grams of NaOH dissolved in 250 mL of solution? (Molar mass of NaOH = 40 g/mol)
questions.explanation: Moles of NaOH = 4/40 = 0.1 mol. Volume in Liters = 250/1000 = 0.25 L. Molarity = 0.1 / 0.25 = 0.4 M.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The maximum number of electrons that can be accommodated in a subshell with azimuthal quantum number l = 2 is:
questions.explanation: The maximum number of electrons in a subshell is given by 2(2l + 1). For l = 2 (d subshell), electrons = 2(2(2) + 1) = 10.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which of the following taxonomic categories includes all the others in hierarchical organization?
questions.explanation: Class is a higher category containing one or more related Orders, which in turn contain Families and Genera.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 1: The Living World

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Methanogens, Halophiles, and Thermoacidophiles belong to which kingdom/group?
questions.explanation: Archaebacteria are special bacteria that live in extreme environments, such as halophiles (salty areas) and methanogens (marshy areas).

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which phylum is characterized by the presence of a water vascular system?
questions.explanation: Echinoderms possess a unique water vascular system that helps in locomotion, capture/transport of food, and respiration.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which brain structure primarily regulates the respiratory rhythm rate?
questions.explanation: A specialized center called the respiratory rhythm center in the medulla region of the brain is primarily responsible for regulating respiration.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 17: Breathing and Exchange of Gases

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: An object of mass 2 kg moves with a constant velocity of 5 m/s. What is the net external force acting on it?
questions.explanation: According to Newton's First Law, if velocity is constant, acceleration is 0. Therefore, Net Force = mass × acceleration = 0 N.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 5: Laws of Motion

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: Which of the following elements has the highest negative electron gain enthalpy?
questions.explanation: Chlorine has the highest negative electron gain enthalpy because Fluorine has a very compact 2p subshell causing inter-electronic repulsions.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
